name: Darius III
role: King of the Achaemenid Empire from 336 to 330 BC
contribution: The thirteenth and last Achaemenid King of Kings of Persia, reigning from 336 BC to his death in 330 BC.
legacy: This person was the thirteenth and last Achaemenid King of Kings of Persia, reigning from 336 BC to his death in 330 BC.

checks.lead: Darius III (Old Persian: 𐎭𐎠𐎼𐎹𐎺𐎢𐏁 Dārayavaʰuš; Ancient Greek: Δαρεῖος Dareios; c. 380 – 330 BC) was the thirteenth and last Achaemenid King of Kings of Persia, reigning from 336 BC to his death in 330 BC.
